d: Donald Trump cast his early ballot in West Palm Beach on Saturday — eight days before the US midterm elections. His approval rating has just hit a record low of 31%, the lowest of either of his presidential terms, with 68% of Americans disapproving of his handling of the economy. Republicans are defending razor-thin majorities in both the House and Senate. Trump's response has been a wave of financial promises — a $5,000 Trump Dividend for every adult American, $90 payments for seniors on Medicare, a $1,776 Warrior Dividend for active military, and $8 billion for farmers.
